Name: (CP) Start With a Dresser
Author: Saah
Description:
It's always bugged me how we start the game with decorative items in our house but not something as crucial as a dresser. Changing the starter house would conflict with other mods that do the same thing, so you get a whole dresser in your mailbox instead! I feel sorry for the mailman.

The dresser will be attached to Robin's apology letter (the one that offers the kitchen upgrade). If you install this mod after that letter has been received, you'll get another letter with the dresser attached. You won't get the dresser if you chose the Meadowlands Farm, because you already start with one there.

[size=4]Installation[/size]
- Install [url=https://nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- Install [url=https://nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- Extract my archive into your Mods folder
[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Full guide on how to install mods[/url]﻿

[size=4]Feedback[/size]
- If you have a bug, please use the Bugs tab instead of Posts!
- If you have a suggestion or question, you can send it in Posts

[size=4]Permissions[/size]
- You can do whatever you want as long as you don't make money from it
- I'd still like you to ask first before doing something, but you can go ahead if I don't reply in 24 hours
- I'd like to implement any translations in this mod file instead of having a separate mod page for each translation, but I'll credit you as a translator, just send me your JSON!

Downloads.Description: I apologize for last version. I shouldn't have changed something so big without giving people a choice. Getting the dresser as an attachment to Robin's apology letter is now a config option (turned on by default).
